# The `to_qiskit` bridge {#sec-to-qiskit}

The file `source/backend/core/to_qiskit.py` rebuilds a Qiskit circuit from a
`NativeCircuit`. It is the opposite of the translator, which goes from Qiskit to
native gates, and it is not a pipeline stage.

## Why it is not inside the translator {.unnumbered}

Three parts of the project need this function: the tomography strategy, the
sampler and the tests. The pipeline modules must not import each other, so the tomography could
not import it from the `translator` package. The function is therefore placed
directly in `core/`, next to `model.py`, `errors.py` and `config.py`. It only
depends on the model, the constants and `qiskit-ionq`, so any module may use it.

## `to_qiskit(native, upto=None)` {.unnumbered}

A Qiskit circuit is rebuilt from a `NativeCircuit`. The native gates of
`qiskit-ionq` are used, and the phases are changed back from radians to turns. A
`virtual_z` operation becomes an `RZ` gate.

This function is used as the oracle in the tests. It is also used by the
tomography strategy, to build the prefix circuits.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `native` | `NativeCircuit` | required | The circuit to rebuild. |
| `upto` | int or `None` | `None` | When it is given, only the first `upto` operations are used. `upto=0` gives an empty circuit. |

**Returns** a `QuantumCircuit`.

## `circuit_from_ops(ops, num_qubits)` {.unnumbered}

The same construction, but from a plain sequence of `NativeOp` and a number of
qubits, without a `NativeCircuit`. `to_qiskit` calls it. The sampler uses it
directly, because it rebuilds the operations from the exported JSON and has no
`NativeCircuit` (and no backend information).

| Parameter | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ops` | sequence of `NativeOp` | The operations, in temporal order. |
| `num_qubits` | int | The width of the circuit. |
